title: FRANCE-SAINT-AIGNAN-CHINA-GOLDEN MONKEYS-DEBUT
text:
Xinhua
08 May 2025, 03:15 GMT+10
(250507) -- SAINT-AIGNAN (FRANCE), May 7, 2025 (Xinhua) -- A Chinese zookeeper feeds golden monkeys inside an enclosure at the ZooPark of Beauval in Saint-Aignan, France, on May 7, 2025. Three golden monkeys from China made their public debut on Wednesday at the ZooPark of Beauval, marking the species' first journey outside Asia. (Xinhua/Sun Xinjing)
